correctness.rationale: Over F2[X]/((X+1)^n), M-I=cD with D invertible when c(1)=0. When c(1)=1, M^3-I=(c+1)^2M(M+I) with both right factors invertible, and M modulo (X+1) has primitive order three. Frobenius powers give scalar-kernel dimensions on two copies of the length-n local ring, yielding exact fixed-space counts, orders and primitive cycle counts by successive subtraction. The boundary cases c=0,c=1 were examined. Exact matrix-rank and order tests passed for 680 symmetric circulants (including all 552 at n=4,8,16), with exhaustive all-state verification for n=4. Finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural, complete orbit classification for every symmetric circulant on an entire infinite family of node counts: period spectrum and all primitive orbit multiplicities depend on just degree parity and one polynomial root multiplicity. This gives a nontrivial dynamical equivalence between graph topologies of different degrees and replaces per-instance matrix period computations by one local invariant. It is a broad structural theorem rather than a routine recoding or arbitrary selected numeric example.
